$comment: Ratchet ceilings for two token-system drift metrics measured in docs/design-system/drift-measurement-2026-09-02.md. Both metrics may only go DOWN. `npm run check:design-drift-ratchet` fails the moment either current count exceeds its ceiling. `npm run check:design-drift-ratchet -- --update` refreshes a ceiling to the current measured count, but only ever lowers or matches it — it refuses to raise a ceiling. Raising one on purpose requires `--update --allow-increase`, which prints the old and new ceiling so the diff is visible in review; do this only with a stated reason (a newly-legitimate dynamic style, or a component whose adoption regressed) recorded in the commit message.
